concepts.proposed_markdown: The POS Customer Area guide has the merchant account request additional payment methods, while adding a method to a store is asynchronous and can be reported by a Management `paymentMethod.created` webhook. After addition, the terminal picks up the method on its next configuration maintenance call or a manual update. A submitted request, a store webhook, and terminal readiness are distinct stages; the source gives no universal scheme or region availability.
